data.long_meaning: Altab is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'altas', meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred abodes of gods and goddesses. Therefore, the name Altab is a fitting tribute to the divine. The name is a reminder of the strength and power of the divine and the reverence and devotion it inspires.

data.etymology: Altab belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altab total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
